what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Cambodia in the United States: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 123 Cambodian asylum seekers in the United States, 7.5% of all asylum seekers from Cambodia.
Refugees from Cambodia, a separate group, live mostly in France, Thailand, Switzerland and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Cambodia from 1995 to 1998, with the KR among the opponents.
It also records an interstate armed conflict between Cambodia and Thailand in 2011 and 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 186 asylum seekers and fell to a low in 2010.
The figure was at its highest, 358, at the end of 2002; the main years of displacement in the data are 2000 to 2006.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United States.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for the United States only.
